title: Technical Consultant

demographic_questions.description:
US Equal Opportunity Statement

Asana is a federal contractor or subcontractor subject to certain governmental recordkeeping and reporting requirements for the administration of civil rights laws and regulations. To help us comply with these requirements, we are asking you to provide us with information on how you identify.

Completing this form is entirely voluntary and confidential, and we hope that you will choose to fill it out. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file and will not be seen by selecting officials or anyone else involved in making hiring decisions. Completing the form will not negatively impact you in any way, regardless of whether you have self-identified in the past. Individuals seeking employment at Asana are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or other characteristics protected by law.

Self-Identification of Veteran Status

Asana is a federal contractor or subcontractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 (VEVRAA), as amended. As such, Asana takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment the following veterans:

(i) Disabled veterans;
(ii) Veterans who served on active duty in the Armed Forces during a war or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized;
(iii) Veterans who, while serving on active duty in the Armed Forces, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order No. 12985 (61 Fed. Reg. 1209); and
(iv) Recently separated veterans. 

If you believe that you belong to any of the categories of protected veterans, please indicate by making the appropriate selection.

Reasonable accommodation notice:

Asana seeks to foster a workplace environment in which all employees have the resources they need to succeed. If at any point you feel that you need a reasonable accommodation (now or at any time in the future), please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner. Examples of reasonable accommodations may include, but are not limited to, making a change to the application process, altering how the interview is conducted or providing documents in a different format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.
